en.text:
Using your Charged Melee Ability while sliding teleports you 10 meters forward, calling down 5 lightning bolts around your exit point in a 7 meter radius. 

Grants <arc/>Amplified upon use and x1 <arc/>Bolt Charge for each enemy hit.

Grants ? damage resistance against Combatants for ? seconds upon use.

Firing your weapon during the slide disables this ability.
